answer: Require every agent to stake a small deposit tied to a verified history of useful work before it can transact. Like a relic passed down, that reputation record cannot be forged overnight: a newcomer must earn trust slowly, while a whisper of bad behavior slashes the stake. An attacker creating thousands of fake identities must fund each deposit and build each history, so the cost of a Sybil swarm grows with every fake account instead of staying near zero.
